prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory with a dedicated temple south of the equator.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country or territory with a dedicated temple lying south of the equator (as of October 2026).
prompts.summary: Many of the Church's temples lie south of the equator, across South America, Africa and the Pacific. Every temple in Brazil is in the Southern Hemisphere, as are those in Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and Zimbabwe. Quito, Ecuador, and Nairobi, Kenya, sit just south of the line.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: All its temples are south of the equator.

answers.name: Ecuador
answers.fact: Guayaquil and Quito are both just south of the equator.

answers.name: Kenya
answers.fact: Nairobi sits just south of the equator.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Latin American country with a temple under construction, not yet dedicated.
prompts.text_original: Pin a Latin American country with a temple under construction but not yet dedicated (as of October 2026).
prompts.citation: Church temple list and ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org (temples under construction), read 26 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: As of October 2026, Latin America has many temples under construction. Brazil has several, including Natal, Teresina and Santos, and Mexico has Torreón, Querétaro and San Luis Potosí. Others are underway at Santiago West Chile, Cali Colombia, Santa Cruz Bolivia and Huehuetenango Guatemala.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: Natal Brazil; Teresina Brazil; Santos Brazil; and others (under construction).

answers.name: Mexico
answers.fact: Torreón Mexico; Querétaro Mexico; San Luis Potosí Mexico (under construction).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country with a Church missionary training center.
prompts.text_original: A country with a Church missionary training center (as of October 2026).
prompts.citation: Church Newsroom, First Presidency calls new leaders for 11 missionary training centers; Newsroom MTC topic page
prompts.note: Only the 11 permanent missionary training centers count. Temporary centers do not.
prompts.summary: As of 2026 the Church has 11 missionary training centers, from Provo in Utah to centers in Mexico, Brazil, Peru, England, Ghana, South Africa, New Zealand and the Philippines. The newest are in Bangkok, Thailand, opened in January 2024, and Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, announced in June 2024. In September 2026 the First Presidency called new presidents for all 11.

answers.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
answers.fact: Democratic Republic of the Congo MTC, in Kinshasa, announced June 2024.

answers.name: Thailand
answers.fact: Thailand MTC, in Bangkok, opened January 2024.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country that Saints names as getting missionaries called at the August 1852 conference.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 2 ch. 10: at the August 1852 conference, the First Presidency called missionaries to these places. Pin one.
prompts.summary: At a special conference in Salt Lake City that began August 28, 1852, the First Presidency called 107 men on missions to India, Siam (now Thailand), China, South Africa, Australia, Jamaica, Barbados and other places. Church leaders also used this conference to publicly explain the practice of plural marriage.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where Russian, Catalan, Polish, Romanian or Icelandic is an official language.
prompts.text_original: A country where Russian, Catalan, Polish, Romanian or Icelandic, all first given the Book of Mormon in 1981, is an official language
prompts.summary: In 1981 the Book of Mormon appeared in Russian, Polish, Romanian, Icelandic and Catalan. That was about a decade before missionaries were permitted in Poland and Romania. Russian also serves Belarus, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan, and Romanian serves Moldova.

answers.name: Russia
answers.fact: The Russian Book of Mormon appeared in 1981.

answers.name: Poland
answers.fact: The Polish Book of Mormon appeared in 1981.

answers.name: Iceland
answers.fact: The Icelandic Book of Mormon appeared in 1981.

answers.name: Romania
answers.fact: The Romanian Book of Mormon appeared in 1981.

answers.name: Andorra
answers.fact: Catalan, translated 1981, is Andorra's only official language.

answers.name: Belarus
answers.fact: Russian, translated 1981, is co-official in Belarus.

answers.name: Kazakhstan
answers.fact: Russian, translated 1981, is officially used in Kazakhstan's state bodies on equal grounds with Kazakh.

answers.name: Kyrgyzstan
answers.fact: Russian, translated 1981, is an official language of Kyrgyzstan.

answers.name: Moldova
answers.fact: Romanian, translated 1981, is Moldova's official language.
